skyaccess-mcp — add the SkyAccess private-jet MCP server to your AI client.

  npx skyaccess-mcp                 register with every supported client found here
  npx skyaccess-mcp doctor          check the server and list its tools
  npx skyaccess-mcp bridge          run the stdio<->HTTP bridge (clients spawn this)

Options
  --url <url>       endpoint to use (default https://mcp.skyaccess.com/mcp)
  --client <id>     force a client even if it is not detected (cursor, claude-desktop)
  --dry-run         show what would be written, write nothing
  -h, --help        this text
